items: Exam Trap: State Legislatures cannot establish tribunals under Article 323A; this power belongs exclusively to Parliament.
Judicial review by High Courts is not excluded by the creation of tribunals.
Remember that CAT was set up in 1985 following the 42nd Amendment.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Articles 323A and 323B were inserted into the Constitution by the 42nd Amendment.
Only Parliament has the authority to establish tribunals under Article 323A.
The Central Administrative Tribunal (CAT) was established in 1985.
High Courts retain their power of judicial review over decisions made by tribunals.
Tribunals are guided by principles of natural justice rather than strict procedural codes.
